name: Task Bridge (Linear, Jira & Notion)
description: Unified issue-to-worktree dispatcher for Linear, Jira, and Notion. Hydrates subtasks and Acceptance Criteria, auto-routes multi-repo workspaces via ticketPrefixes, reads CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md guidelines, enforces Plan-First approval via tool hooks, monitors your In-Flight Fleet with Verify AC, In Review/Done transitions, comment feedback, and one-click Fleet/worktree cleanup.

commands.title: Task Bridge: Sync Tickets (Linear, Jira & Notion)
Task Bridge: Move Active Workspace Ticket to In Review

settings.title: Default Coding Agent
settings.description: Agent CLI to launch when dispatching a ticket into a worktree.

settings.title: Branch Prefix Mode
settings.description: Auto-select prefix by ticket kind or force one type prefix.

settings.title: Feature Branch Prefix
settings.description: Prefix for feature/story tickets (e.g. feat, feature, story).

settings.title: Bug Branch Prefix
settings.description: Prefix for bug/defect tickets (e.g. fix, bugfix, hotfix).

settings.title: Chore Branch Prefix
settings.description: Prefix for chore/maintenance tickets (e.g. chore, task, refactor).

settings.title: Require Plan Approval Before Coding
settings.description: Instruct coding agents to present an implementation plan and wait for approval before editing code.

settings.title: Enforce Plan Lock via Tool Hook
settings.description: Block Edit/Write/mutating Bash tools via agent.tool.before (Claude Code) until you click Approve Plan in Task Bridge.

settings.title: Fleet Auto-Sync Interval
settings.description: Automatically refresh tickets and ticket comments while work is in flight in Fleet.

settings.title: Local Files to Copy into New Worktrees
settings.description: Comma-separated relative paths (e.g. .env.local, .claude/settings.local.json) copied from the primary worktree on dispatch.

settings.title: Auto-move ticket to In Progress
settings.description: Automatically transition the ticket status to 'In Progress' when starting work.

settings.title: Include completion runbook in agent prompt
settings.description: Append instructions so the agent knows how to comment and move the ticket to 'In Review' when done.

settings.title: Notion Tasks Database ID
settings.description: 32-character Notion Database ID to query tasks from (configure the Notion API token in the Task Bridge panel).

settings.title: Notion Status Property Name
settings.description: Name of the Status or Select property in your Notion database.

settings.title: Ticket Sync Limit
settings.description: Maximum number of tickets to fetch per provider during sync.

settings.title: Jira Sprint JQL
settings.description: Custom JQL used when the Sprint scope filter is active.
settings.default: sprint in openSprints() AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done
settings.placeholder: sprint in openSprints() AND assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done

settings.title: Default Jira Project Key
settings.description: Optional default Jira project key when registering work from an unlinked worktree.

settings.title: Default Jira Issue Type ID
settings.description: Optional default Jira issue type ID when creating a ticket from an unlinked worktree.
